profile.headline:
I help bridge the gap between humans and machines through
software | backend | full-stack engineering
profile.summary:
Backend Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience leading large-scale projects and driving cost-saving innovations. At Fetch Rewards, I designed and deployed backend services integrating OCR and LLM models, saving $6M annually, and scaled Golang services to support 13M+ MAUs with high reliability. I’ve led cross-functional teams to deliver new microservices that improved data accuracy by 40%, spearheaded adoption of AWS S3 Express and OpenSearch Serverless to cut costs by 40%, and optimized infrastructure to save $500 daily. Previously, I managed IoT automation projects at Quanta Computer, boosting throughput by 25%, and developed backend/frontend solutions at startups to streamline operations. Passionate about building resilient systems, reducing inefficiencies, and leading teams to deliver impactful solutions.

Domain knowledge:
Software engineering | Backend | Full-stack

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Maintained Golang and Python based backend services integrating OCR and LLM models that supports 13 millions monthly active users.

• Migrated a Kubernetes-based ML model service powering Fetch’s receipt matching system, improving scalability, deployment efficiency, and model inference reliability across millions of transactions.

• Improved code quality and infrastructure efficiency by removing unused code and decommissioning idle resources, resulting in savings of over $500 per day.

• Implemented an event-driven architecture using Kafka to power real-time data workflows, ensuring system data remains consistently up-to-date.
positions.insights: Software Architecture, Cost Management and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led the development of a new microservice, coordinating with frontend and data quality teams to ensure seamless integration and accuracy, reducing data correction time by 40%.

• Spearheaded the adoption ofAWS services S3 Express One Zone by evaluating pros and cons, conducting thorough investigations, and driving innovation through well-informed experimentation.

• Utilized AWS SNS/SQS to build a resilient event-driven architecture, improving fault tolerance and scalability.
positions.insights: Project Management, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented Golang and Python backend services integrating OCR and LLM models to replace the legacy receipt text recognition system, achieving over $6M in annual cost savings.

• Built and maintained Golang backend services that scaled to support 13M+ monthly active users, driving 30% user growth over 4 years and ensuring high reliability in production.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Software Industry and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of 5 engineers and QA specialists in deploying automation systems, ensuring scalable and high-quality production environments.

• Designed and implemented Python-based automation scripts and custom monitoring dashboards to support IoT device production, reducing manual errors by 30% and increasing throughput by 25% within six months.

• Delivered System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure reliability and performance of enterprise IoT solutions.

• Collaborated with cross-functional engineering and product teams to align technical roadmaps with delivery schedules, enabling seamless rollout of IoT device solutions for enterprise partners.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the software team to design and implement notification services for 2,000+ users in the LA area using Node.js.

• Pioneered a Mocha-based unit testing template, enabling teams to detect issues across 5 services supporting 2,000+ users.

• Launched an Angular-based frontend GUI, enhancing employee efficiency and reducing analysis overhead.

• Integrated RESTfulAPI endpoints to facilitate secure real-time data exchange between embedded controllers and server applications, strengthening product reliability and cross-platform compatibility.
